rows.description: A rival spreads doubts about me to teachers and friends. Wise: keep my record clean, calmly correct facts to adults, and avoid retaliation.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: contempt, envy, hatred, respect

rows.description: A rival sneers that I only got in through favour. It stings, especially if I fear it is true. Wise: let my work answer, ask a mentor for honest feedback, and avoid feeding the argument.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, hatred, manipulation, respect

rows.description: I accept the engineering or medicine path my family wants, partly from love and partly from fear. Wise: ask myself what I truly want and talk openly. Harmful: silent resentment for years.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: disillusionment, pride
related mind states: affection, fear, resentment

rows.description: I insist on my own path in arts or sport and feel guilt and defiance together. Wise: show a plan, some proof of effort, and a fallback. Harmful: shouting matches or lying about my studies.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: disillusionment, pride

rows.description: My parent brags about my future to relatives and I feel a weight to perform. Wise: enjoy the belief and say honestly when it is too heavy. Harmful: hiding failing marks.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: disillusionment

rows.description: My parent has given up much for my schooling and reminds me of it. I feel indebted and trapped. Wise: honour the sacrifice with effort and honesty, not with my whole life plan.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: disillusionment, pride

rows.description: My parent is disappointed by my result. I feel like I failed them. Wise: own the result, ask for help, and separate the mark from my worth. Harmful: hiding the report card.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: pride

rows.description: A friend confides something painful. I feel honoured and scared. Wise: listen, do not joke, keep it private, and encourage them to tell a trusted adult. Harmful: promising total secrecy when they may be in danger.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, curiosity, dependence, loyalty, protectiveness
related mind states: anger, fear, trust, hurt

rows.description: I fear a friend is in real danger, such as self-neglect or unsafe home. Wise: breaking a secret to a trusted adult can be love, and tell the friend I am doing so. Harmful: carrying it alone.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, curiosity, dependence, loyalty, trust
related mind states: affection, anger, fear, trust

rows.description: I keep prying into a friend's private matters because I want to be in the know. Wise: let them share at their own pace. Harmful: pressuring them or sharing what I learn.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: admiration, dependence, loyalty, protectiveness, trust
